source: Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 via the Shopify connector (read-only queries; no mutations)
scope: appInstallations (default, privacy PUBLIC, privacy PRIVATE, category CHANNEL), app(id) and appByHandle lookups for the apps named in the brief, currentAppInstallation scopes, and scriptTags (denied). Web pixels and script tags were read from storefront HTML captured earlier (live homepage 2026-11-26, unpublished preview 2026-11-27), because the Admin API can't list them for this client.
notes: The Admin API's appInstallations list is NOT a complete inventory. It omits Sezzle, Concierge, EZ Preorder, Ordersify and UpPromote, yet their theme extensions or script tags were loading on the storefront on 2026-11-26/27. Lookups by app id or handle return installation: null for them (or find no app under the handle tried). Treat Admin → Apps as the source of truth (A-02).
scriptTags: 'Access denied for scriptTags field'. The connector has no read_script_tags scope (currentAppInstallation.accessScopes lists none).

Web pixels: webPixel(id) returns only the calling app's own pixel, and Customer events custom pixels aren't exposed in the Admin API, so the list below comes from the storefront's webPixelsConfigList.
Fresh storefront reads weren't possible today: curl gets a bot-verification page (HTTP 403).
No billing or subscription fields were queried (activeSubscriptions, pricing).
